en.headline: Driver dies after private car hits central divider in Fanling
en.dek: A man in his 50s was trapped after a car left the carriageway on Pak Wo Road on Tuesday night; police later found suspected drug-taking equipment in the vehicle.
body: A driver died on Tuesday night after a private car left the carriageway and struck a central divider on Pak Wo Road in Fanling, police said.

The collision was reported at about 10.19pm near Fung Ying Seen Koon. Firefighters freed the driver, a man in his 50s, who was unconscious and trapped in the vehicle. He was taken to North District Hospital and was certified dead at 11.28pm.

Police said officers later found an item inside the car that they suspected was used to take dangerous drugs. The New Territories North traffic special investigation team is investigating the cause of the crash.
No other vehicles were reported to have been involved. Police have not given a public account of the driver’s medical condition before the collision.

zh.headline: 粉嶺百和路私家車撞壘 司機送院不治
zh.dek: 周二晚一輛私家車在粉嶺百和路近蓬瀛仙館失控撞向路中石壘，50多歲司機被困送院後不治；警方其後在車內檢獲懷疑吸毒工具。
body: 警方表示，周二晚上粉嶺百和路發生致命交通意外，一輛私家車駛離行車線後撞向路中分隔石壘，司機送院後不治。
意外約於晚上10時19分發生，地點近蓬瀛仙館。消防員到場救出被困、當時昏迷的50多歲男司機，由救護車送往北區醫院，晚上11時28分證實死亡。
警方其後在車內檢獲一件懷疑用作吸食危險藥物的工具。新界北總區交通部特別調查隊正調查意外原因。
警方未有公布現場是否涉及其他車輛，亦未有交代司機撞車前的身體狀況。
